title: Epic: Shared Flexible Impact, Prestressed Shaft and Vibroacoustic Models
body:
## Status as of 2026-09-19

Status as of 2026-09-19
- Closed: T1 #5069 (#5077), T2 #5071 (#5082), T6 #5075 (#5083 versioned impact study wire), T4 review children #5145/#5147/#5151/#5153/#5160 (PRs #5146/#5149/#5152/#5154/#5162), T5 children #5155/#5157 (#5156/#5159).
- Open: T3 #5072 (measured coefficient/grip/FRF identification), T4 #5073 (face/hosel modes, general convergence, held-out force/spin maps, hosted 60 s timeout on the Frechet path), T5 #5074 (calibration identity, radiation, held-out observers).
- Cross-repo: UpstreamDrift #9700/#9920 consumer, AffineDrift #4253 theory.

---

## Objective
Implement reusable, scientifically qualified impact and vibroacoustic models in Tools, extending the existing golf_club, swing_sim.impact and signal/audio capabilities. AffineDrift supplies theory; UpstreamDrift consumes versioned provider contracts rather than copying kernels.

## Native Sub-Issues and Dependencies
- [x] #5069 (IA-T1): Full-tensor rigid-contact mobility and normal-impulse reference; PR #5077 merged as f7254461399ac18e5667a0215afd90a9ebff9d22. This completes the bounded rigid reference, not flexible/acoustic qualification.
- [x] #5071 (IA-T2): PR #5082 merged as80d580d57ac7ebd2267340f5f605fd58bf016fbf, qualifying the bounded lumped coupling model, event termination and disjoint work semantics. Physical coefficient and higher-tier qualification remain separate.
- [ ] #5072 (IA-T3): Distributed prestressed shaft and passive six-dimensional grip impedance; use T1/T2 limits.
- [ ] #5073 (IA-T4): Finite-duration off-center ball/face contact coupled to head and shaft modes; depends on T1–T3.
- [ ] #5074 (IA-T5): Calibrated vibroacoustic transfer and sound analysis; measurement ingestion can start early, predictive pressure depends on T3/T4 qualification.
- [ ] #5075 (IA-T6): Versioned reports and truthful application surfaces; expose model level and evidence limitations, integrate qualified T1–T5 results.

## Integration and Acceptance
Companions: D-sorganization/AffineDrift#4253 and D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift#9700. The governing provider design is docs/specs/IMPACT_DYNAMICS_ACOUSTICS.md in the implementation PR.

Require test-first analytic limits, full tensor/frame covariance, momentum and work/energy closure, passive dissipation, gyroscopic zero-work checks, contact event refinement and independent time/mesh/modal convergence. Enforce typed units/frames and explicit invalid-input contracts, LoD and DRY, additive API and provider-pin compatibility. Require calibrated and held-out physical measurements before effect-size claims; synthetic sonification is not predicted sound pressure. Preserve exact provenance and update root/package turnover documents with every implementation commit.

Focused provider-import prerequisite: D-sorganization/UpstreamDrift#9735 (fresh contract failure reproduced). The rigid reference delivers only T1. Keep this epic and the flexible/acoustic milestones open until their independent acceptance gates pass.


## Current implementation and qualification (2026-09-10)

T3 numerical shaft PR#5133 is merged; #5072 remains open for its full qualification scope. T4 review sequence is organized in #5073: #5145/PR#5146 instantaneous coupling, #5147/PR#5149 temporal contact, #5151/PR#5152 adaptive normal events, and #5153 prescribed force/couple histories. The latest prescribed-load archive passes406 Windows/Linux controls; source and JUnit identities, retained failures and remaining obligations are recorded in Tools docs/development/impact-acoustics/LOAD_HISTORY_RESULTS.json. These tests do not qualify measured player effects, sound pressure or sweetness.

Final cross-repository dependency alignment remains with combined provider PR#5141 and its coordinated UpstreamDrift consumer. Standalone launcher PR#5144 is closed unmerged and its correction is incorporated there. Finite-duration objective friction, face/hosel modes, general convergence and matched interventions, calibrated radiation and blinded perceptual data remain open. Keep this epic open until each independent acceptance gate is met.
